Slop Orders · free, in your browser

Print a delivery note or packing slip

Put a delivery note in the box: your company, the order number and date, who it goes to, every line with its quantity and unit, and a line for the receiver to sign. No prices are shown.

Make a delivery note

How to do it

  1. Open the order in Slop Orders.
  2. Choose Delivery note.
  3. Check the lines: SKU, description, quantity and unit, with the number of lines and items.
  4. Choose Print…, or save it as PDF from the print dialog.
  5. Choose Address label to open a 4 × 2 inch parcel label in SlopLabel.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Orders runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Why are there no prices on it?

A delivery note goes in the parcel, so it lists only what was sent and how many. The prices are on the order and the invoice.

Is a delivery note the same as a packing slip?

They are used for the same thing: a list of what is in the shipment. This one also has a line for the receiver's signature.

Can I print a shipping label too?

Yes. Address label opens the customer's address as a 4 × 2 inch label in SlopLabel, ready to print.
